Class SecretSlots

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.security.SecretSlots
public final class SecretSlots extends Object
The names a program reads from an Atecc608 and the data slot that holds each one. The program builds it once, at startup, with the slot numbers its provisioning used; the driver itself knows no names. A name is added with add(String, int), and a lookup for a name that was never added returns -1.

  • Method Details

    • add

      public SecretSlots add(String name, int slot)
      Maps name to data slot slot. Fails when the table is full, the slot is outside the chip's data slots, or the name is already mapped, so a wrong table is caught at startup rather than as a missing secret.
